research_conclusion: The momentum class (long the previous N-day return, hold 1 day) is the first non-falsified candidate of this research series and is admitted to the evidence base as candidate positive evidence. Parameter robustness: the REGIME_STABLE positive edge persists across lookbacks 3/5/10/20 (GOOGL, AMZN, META, TSLA uniformly REGIME_STABLE; 9/10 nominally significant at every lookback; 2/10 CONSISTENT_WITH_NOISE; 3/10 idiosyncratically unstable). Concentration analysis: the edge is DISTRIBUTED across the collected large-cap universe at short horizons (HHI 0.1137 vs uniform ~0.10, top-1 16.3% of positive edge, max/median ratio 1.62; all 10 assets EFFECTIVE_STRONG), i.e. it rests on a broad class effect rather than one or two names — the opposite of the MA-crossover finding where the edge concentrated in a single historical regime. Only at lookback 20 does the distribution become concentrated (HHI 0.334, top-1 56.6%, max/median 10.67), consistent with noisier longer-horizon momentum. Admitted caveats: 0/10 survive family-wise Bonferroni at alpha 0.005; 2/10 assets at the noise threshold; single-asset (not cross-sectional) construction; the synthetic sweep is a tooling-validity check only. The next frontier item is the cross-sectional momentum variant.
